content.name: Bianca Russo
content.title: Customer Experience Team Leader
content.summary: Customer service leader with 14 years in energy, private health insurance and telecommunications contact centres. Leads a team of 16 consultants, cut complaints referred to the ombudsman by 35% and is known for turning difficult customers into loyal ones.

experience.title: Contact Centre Consultant
bullets: Took inbound calls on bills, connections and concessions for residential electricity and gas customers.
Applied state concessions and hardship program options correctly, earning a 96% accuracy score in compliance audits.
Covered the outbound welcome call queue for new customers, reaching about 120 households a week.

experience.title: Senior Customer Service Consultant
bullets: Handled escalated member queries on extras claims, waiting periods and hospital cover, including calls from distressed members before surgery.
Acted as team leader on rotation, managing schedules and breaks for 12 consultants on the floor.
Designed a cover-explainer checklist with the product team that reduced repeat calls about waiting periods by about 18%.
Assessed and paid complex extras claims up to $2,500 within delegated authority.

experience.title: Customer Experience Team Leader
bullets: Lead a team of 16 phone and chat consultants supporting 90,000 NBN and mobile customers.
Rebuilt the complaint process in line with the Telecommunications Consumer Protections Code, lowering TIO referrals by 35% in two years.
Run weekly coaching and monthly one-on-ones; four consultants from my team have been promoted to senior roles.
Work with workforce planning on rosters, keeping service level at 80% of calls answered in 60 seconds through peak periods.
Report weekly on NPS, complaint themes and handle time to the head of customer operations.

achievements.title: Leader of the Year 2023
achievements.detail: Chosen across Merri Creek Telco's customer operations for team results and staff engagement.

achievements.title: Hardship program improvement
achievements.detail: Helped redesign the hardship call flow at Southbank Energy Retail, later used as the team standard.
